profile.ja: 五車学園に通う学生。磯咲伊織の姉で、ふうまのクラスメイト。学生の身ながら、いくつもの任務をこなす優秀な生徒。任務の成功率は高いのだが、慈悲深い性格で、しばしば敵にも情けをかけてしまうことがある。中にはその慈悲深さに感動して、彼女のためなら対魔忍に協力してもいいという敵も現れるほどであり、アサギたちはそれも彼女の能力の一つであると考えて見守っている。クラスメイトであるふうまに恋心を抱いており、それが彼女にとっての初恋。しかし、そんな思いは胸の内に潜めて、影で彼を見守っている。
profile.en: Isozaki Inori is a student at Gosha Academy and the older sister of Isozaki Iori, as well as a classmate of Fuuma. Though still a student, she excels at completing numerous missions, boasting a high success rate. Her compassionate nature sometimes leads her to show mercy to enemies. Her kindness has even moved some foes to the point where they'd cooperate with the Taimanin on her behalf, and Asagi and the others consider this another facet of her ability. She harbors a crush on her classmate Fuuma, her first love, but keeps those feelings hidden, watching over him from the shadows.

text.ja: あ、れ……？　ふうまくん！　ふうまくんじゃない！　会えて嬉しいわ……運命を感じてしまいそう、フフッ
text.en: Ah, could it be...? Fuuma-kun! It's not Fuuma-kun! I'm so happy to see you... I feel like it's fate, hehe...

text.ja: ねぇ、お膝に来てくれる？　変なことなんてしないわよ。耳かきをしてあげるだけ。……ね？
text.en: Hey, come sit on my lap? I won't do anything weird, I promise. I'll just scratch your ears for you... okay?

text.ja: ん？　何してるの？　……あぁ、課題ね。私も一緒にやっていい？
text.en: Huh? What are you doing? ...Oh, homework, right? Can I help you with it?

text.ja: 次のお休みの日って何か予定ある？　もしないのなら、お買い物につきあってほしいんだけど……駄目？
text.en: Do you have any plans for the next day off? If not, I was thinking maybe you could accompany me shopping... would that be okay?

text.ja: え？　お腹が空いたの？　……じゃあ、何か作ってあげるね。ふうまくんは、何が好き？
text.en: What's wrong? Are you hungry? ...Well, in that case, I'll make something for you. What does Fuuma-kun like?

text.ja: 何か疲れてるように見えるよ？　今日はゆっくりお風呂に入ったら？　背中流してあげるから
text.en: You look like you're tired. Why don't you take a relaxing bath today? I'll wash your back for you.

text.ja: 離れたくないの、あなたと……絶対に。ずっと傍にいる為なら、私は……何だってするわ
text.en: I don't want to be apart from you... ever. If it means I can be by your side, I'll do anything.
